A prayer which provides the Repose buff over several days. New corpses delivered by Donkey now will have more {{Skull|Red}} and {{Skull|White}}.

It is unlocked via "[[Technologies|Embalming]]" in the tech tree, and can be crafted at the [[Desk]] or [[Desk II]].

As with all sermons you need to reach the minimum {{Church Rating}} to get the effect and bonus faith/donations
